summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 providing a weekly update on its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program and bitcoin holdings. For the period April 27 to May 3, 2026, no shares of any of its series of perpetual preferred stock (STRF, STRC, STRK, STRD) were sold, and no bitcoin purchases were made. Proceeds of $82.0 million from sales of Class A common stock (MSTR) are reported, with aggregate remaining ATM capacity of approximately $53.6 billion. This is a routine operational disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return.
